parsed.explanation: No presentation offence and no documented facility, custody or border rule, but the worst documented feature is tier-2: security forces using vague morality/debauchery provisions to harass LGBT people with impunity (June 2024), plus a state-directed smear campaign inciting violence and a 2023 cybercrime law with intrusive surveillance raising discovery risk. Social hostility is high (93% regional rejection, homosexuality-framed). Article 8's surgical ban and absent gender recognition are resident-facing, not visitor exposure; no custody or emergency-care practice is documented. Tolerated capital cafés are a small positive. No documented killings or universal exclusion keep this out of the severe tiers; state-tolerated harassment with no working remedy, hostile society and active official hostility keep it well below Reduced Risk.
